system.description: At 6th level, you’re prepared for most anything, including responding quickly to physical violence. When you are the target of a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-maneuvers.Item.9umrahwm68f81d7l]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-maneuvers.Item.zzg7j7cb0vkgctwi]{Knockdown}, or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-maneuvers.Item.md35qozzy2fxy2o6]{Shove} combat maneuver, or an enemy attempts to press the attack on you, you can expend your reaction to make a ranged attack against them with a readied light firearm. On a successful hit, their maneuver fails, though you still take basic maneuver damage. If they attempted to press the attack, they continue to provide advantage to attackers, but do not gain the expertise die against you.

activation.reactionTrigger: Target of a Grapple, Knockdown, or Shove combat maneuver, or an enemy attempts to press the attack on you
